title: 第19章 庶子的交易第20章 金丹分离术
lines: 夜色深沉，小院内寂静无声。
影舞站在窗外，蒙着面纱，只露出一双灵动而警惕的眼睛。
她的气息收敛得极好，若不是林澈一直保持警惕，根本发现不了她的到来。
“合作？”
林澈心里诧异，但不动声色，“影舞姑娘是天机阁的人，找我合作什么？”
“不是天机阁。”
影舞说，“是我个人，想和林大夫做一笔交易。”
她环顾四周，低声道：“这里说话不方便，林大夫可否让我进去？”
林澈沉吟片刻，打开窗户。
影舞如狸猫般翻入，落地无声。
她迅速在房间内布下几道隔音、隔绝神识的简易禁制，动作熟练，显然不是第一次做这种事。
“林大夫不必紧张。”
影舞取下蒙面纱，露出一张清丽却略显苍白的面容，约莫二十七八岁，“我虽然是天机阁的人，但和他们不是一路人。”
林澈没有放松警惕，问道：“那你是哪路人？”
“白家庶女，白雨。”
女子轻声道，“我母亲是白世宏的妾室，五年前病逝。
我在白家地位低下，被送到天机阁学习，实际上……是作为人质和实验观察对象。”
白家庶女？
林澈心中一动。
他确实听说过，白世宏有几个庶出的子女，但都不受重视，有些甚至下落不明。
“你有什么证据？”
白雨从怀中取出一块玉佩，上面刻着一个“白”
字，背面有小字：“庶女白雨，庚辰年立”
这是白家子女的身份玉佩，做不了假。
林澈接过玉佩，感应了一下，确实有白家血脉的气息。
“就算你是白家庶女，为什么要找我合作？天机阁不是给了你力量吗？”
林澈试探道。
“力量？”
白雨苦笑，挽起左臂的衣袖。
只见她的手臂上，布满了细密的、暗红色的缝合痕迹，皮肤下隐约有金属光泽透出。
更骇人的是，手腕处嵌着一块指甲盖大小的黑色晶体，与黑石碎片的材质相似，正散发着微弱的暗绿色光芒。
“这是‘灵能增幅器’。”
白雨满脸忧伤，声音苦涩，“天机阁给我植入的，说是能提升修炼速度。
但代价是……我每动用一次灵力，这块晶体就会吸收我的生命力，同时向天机阁发送我的位置和身体数据。”
她眼中闪过恨意，悠悠地说：“我在他们眼里，不过是一个移动的实验样本罢了。
如果不是我还有利用价值，恐怕早就被改造成外面那些进化者了。”
林澈用“基础解剖视觉”
检查，确认她没说谎。
content_en:
The night was dark and the small courtyard was silent.
Yingwu stood outside the window, covered with a veil, only revealing a pair of smart and alert eyes.
Her aura was so well controlled that if Lin Che hadn't been vigilant, he wouldn't have noticed her arrival.
"Cooperation?"
Lin Che was surprised, but kept her composure, "Miss Yingwu is from Tianji Pavilion, why do you want me to cooperate?"
"It's not Tianji Pavilion."
Yingwu said, "It's me personally who wants to make a deal with Doctor Lin."
She looked around and whispered: "It's not convenient to talk here. Doctor Lin, can you let me in?"
Lin Che pondered for a moment and opened the window.
Shadow Dance rolled in like a civet cat and landed silently.
She quickly set up a few simple restrictions in the room to isolate sound and spiritual consciousness. Her movements were skillful, and it was obviously not the first time she had done this kind of thing.
"Doctor Lin, don't be nervous."
Yingwu took off her veil, revealing a beautiful but slightly pale face. She was about 27 or 28 years old. "Although I am from Tianji Pavilion, I am not from the same group as them."
Lin Che did not let down her guard and asked, "Then where are you from?"
"The concubine of the Bai family, Bai Yu."
The woman whispered, "My mother was Bai Shihong's concubine and died of illness five years ago.
I have a low status in the Bai family and was sent to Tianji Pavilion to study. In fact... I was used as a hostage and experimental observation object. "
The concubine of the Bai family?
Lin Che's heart moved.
He had indeed heard that Bai Shihong had several children born from concubines, but they were not taken seriously, and some were even missing.
"What evidence do you have?"
Bai Yu took out a jade pendant from his arms with the word "白" engraved on it.
There are small characters on the back: "Bai Yu, a concubine, was born in the year of Gengchen."
This is the identity jade pendant of the Bai family children and cannot be faked.
Lin Che took the jade pendant and sensed it, and found that it indeed smelled of the Bai family's bloodline.
"Even if you are the concubine of the Bai family, why do you want to cooperate with me? Didn't Tianji Pavilion give you power?"
Lin Che probed.
"Power?"
Bai Yu smiled bitterly and rolled up the sleeve of his left arm.
Her arms were covered with fine, dark red suture marks, and there was a faint metallic luster under the skin.
What's even more shocking is that there is a black crystal about the size of a fingernail embedded in the wrist. It is made of a similar material to the black stone fragments and is emitting a faint dark green light.
"This is a 'psionic amplifier'."
Bai Yu's face was filled with sadness and his voice was bitter, "The implant Tianji Pavilion gave me is said to increase the speed of my cultivation.
But the price is... every time I use my spiritual power, this crystal will absorb my life force and at the same time send my location and body data to Tianji Pavilion. "
Hatred flashed in her eyes, and she said leisurely: "In their eyes, I am just a moving experimental sample.
If I weren't still valuable, I would have been transformed into those evolved people outside. "
Lin Che uses "Basic Anatomy Vision"
Check to make sure she's not lying.
